scope: Actual Assets/Game.unity in Unity Play mode. A -> B -> A -> B via the saved host's standard Button.onClick handlers. All game/A/B storage uses a dedicated QA profile. No fruit is clicked and no level is completed. The B balance marker is explicit test setup using original GameManagerWZ.AddCoin(12.34, rewardLevel: 3), not earned gameplay. Portrait screenshots render the actual live scene instances and gameplay camera into a temporary RenderTexture, restoring camera/canvas state afterwards. They are no-notch diagnostic actual-instance renders with safe-area adapters temporarily paused, not phone captures, viewport/pixel parity proof, prefab fixtures or mockups. The optional settlement scenario creates an explicitly labelled QA reward through the production service, without clearing the fruit board.
